tasks.title: Add explicit execution and PMO focus lanes
tasks.objective: Replace the single mutable Session selection with a typed focus context that classifies and records execution and PMO Sessions independently.
tasks.outcome: Cross-surface navigation uses execution focus and PMO opens without changing it.
acceptance: Execution focus stores a unique bounded MRU history and current Session.
PMO focus has a separate current Session and is never added to execution history.
A focused store test fails when PMO selection writes execution focus.

verification.proves: Focus classification, MRU ordering, and PMO isolation.
Store and focus abstraction compile cleanly.
The abstraction is defined and consumed by the product store.

tasks.title: Expose execution focus history in Agents and PMO context
tasks.objective: Make the execution focus history useful without mixing it into PMO identity.
tasks.outcome: Agents can return to recent execution Sessions and PMO prompts receive a read-only execution-context summary.
acceptance: Agents surface renders a compact recent execution rail and clicking an item restores the execution focus.
PMO prompt context contains execution history only and does not include the PMO Session.
A focused UI test and source contract verify both production callers.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/global-agents-board.test.tsx test/agent-focus-context.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Agents rail and PMO context are connected.

tasks.title: Preserve focus lanes across surface switches and restart
tasks.objective: Ensure Workspaces, Agents and Board resolve the execution focus while PMO stays isolated and durable.
tasks.outcome: Returning to Workspaces reopens the original execution Tab/Region after Agents or PMO interactions, including after hydration.
acceptance: Main-surface navigation uses execution focus only.
PMO open/focus leaves execution Session, history and Board linkage unchanged.
Persisted focus fields are restored independently.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/session-context-navigation.test.ts test/pmo-focus-isolation.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

verification.proves: Durable focus facts survive recovery probe.
